platform_statement.decision: Supported as interface/runtime requirements, not proof of execution on every Python/OS/architecture.

platform_statement.limitation: This Windows static check does not newly qualify semantic repair execution on non-ARM64 systems. Historical nativeLinuxARM64 execution qualification remains unchanged.
